prompt: Which president featured on a U.S. coin in 1972 served the longest as President of the United States of America?
answer: **Dwight D. Eisenhower** was featured on the 1972 Eisenhower dollar. He served as the **34th U.S. president from 1953 to 1961**, completing two four-year terms—**eight years in total**.
